title: Abolish the Export-Import Bank
proposal: This section says the Export-Import Bank, which uses taxpayer-backed loans and guarantees to support exports, should be shut down. It argues the Bank mostly helps large, well-financed companies.
quote: understanding of what competitiveness is and how it is achieved and maintained. The Bank should be abolished.
contested: de Rugy (abolish EXIM) view; Hazelton's section argues for keeping the Bank

title: Do not reorient the Export-Import Bank to fight China
proposal: This section says efforts to turn the Export-Import Bank into a tool for competing with China will fail and should not be used as a reason to keep it.
quote: any attempts to reorient the agency and make it a weapon with which to fight against China are going to fail.
contested: de Rugy (abolish EXIM) view; Hazelton's section argues the Bank is needed to counter China

title: Keep the Export-Import Bank as a tool to counter China
proposal: This section says the United States should keep the Export-Import Bank so American companies can compete for overseas deals, especially against China's large export financing.
quote: and to relinquish EXIM as a powerful tool in America's asymmetrical warfare toolbox.
contested: Hazelton (keep EXIM) view; de Rugy's section says the Bank should be abolished
